title: Battle of Los Angeles and the Marshall briefing
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Battle of Los Angeles and the Marshall briefing, about 1942 at Los Angeles, California, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the Battle of Los Angeles in 1942 where a UFO shows up and like flies down the coast and George Marshall was briefed to that.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of the Battle of Los Angeles in 1942, during the Second World War, when he says a UFO showed up and flew down the California coast. According to Michels, George Marshall, the top general of the US Army, was briefed about it, which would mean the highest military levels knew of such objects even before the war ended.
